Leisha Pickering, a former pastry chef, founded Musee
Bath in 2011 with a vision to care for her community by
creating handcrafted products that would provide jobs
and spread joy. Drawing from her expertise in working with high-quality
ingredients, Leisha crafted a line of whimsical, luxurious bath products.
Musee proudly offers second-chance employment to women in
